title: FedReady: Bounded Agents for Federation Formation
title_zh: FedReady：用于联邦构建的有界智能体

paragraphs.en: Federated learning (FL) runtimes standardize aggregation and deployment, but each new study still requires federation formation : selecting task-eligible sites and preparing their local data and task code for federated training or analysis. This preparation recurs when the target changes, while raw records and site-private mappings are excluded from cross-site FL messages. We present FedReady, a system that performs federation formation with bounded LLM agents. Agents propose shared contracts, local adapters, and task code; the runtime owns workflow state and accepts artifacts only after checks tied to their digests. Candidate site discovery prioritizes recall; local eligibility verification checks task support before site admission. Once participating sites and artifacts are fixed, conventional federated training or analysis proceeds without readiness agents. Across 39 simulated retinal sites and four tasks, discovery reaches recall 1.00 at precision 0.65; local eligibility verification removes all 17 false positives without losing an eligible site–task pair. The participating sites supply 45,575 task-record instances and complete four 100-round jobs, including one with a runtime-generated contract. Across ten patient cohorts, preparation supports seven patient populations and holds endpoints at three sources as unsupported. Comparison with manually prepared reference populations and analysis (the manual reference) gives a maximum survival-curve difference of 0.001133. We also analyze 19 development failures, targeted classification ablations, and standalone and heterogeneous agent configurations. These results establish the feasibility of task-specific data preparation before ordinary FL training or analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 联邦学习（FL）运行时对聚合与部署进行了标准化，但每项新研究仍需进行联邦组建：选择符合任务条件的站点，并为其准备本地数据和用于联邦训练或分析的任务代码。 当目标发生变化时，这一准备工作会重复进行，而原始记录和站点私有映射不会被纳入跨站点的联邦学习消息中。 我们提出 FedReady，一个使用受限 LLM 智能体执行联邦组建的系统。 智能体提出共享契约、本地适配器和任务代码；运行时负责管理工作流状态，只有在通过与其摘要绑定的检查后才接受产物。 候选站点发现以召回率为优先；本地资格验证在站点准入之前检查任务支持情况。 一旦参与站点和产物确定，常规的联邦训练或分析即可进行，无需就绪智能体。 在 39 个模拟视网膜站点和四项任务中，发现步骤在精确率 0.65 下达到召回率 1.00；本地资格验证剔除了全部 17 个假阳性，且未丢失任何符合条件的站点—任务配对。 参与站点提供了 45,575 条任务记录实例，并完成了四个 100 轮的作业，其中一个使用运行时生成的契约。 在十个患者队列中，准备工作支持了七个人群，并将三个来源的队列判定为不支持。 与人工准备的参考人群和分析（人工参考）相比，生存曲线的最大差异为 0.001133。 我们还分析了 19 次开发失败、针对性的分类消融实验，以及独立与异构的智能体配置。 这些结果证明了在常规联邦学习训练或分析之前进行任务特定数据准备的可行性。

paragraphs.en: Federated learning (FL) lets institutions train a shared model without centralizing their records ( McMahan et al., 2017 ) . Production runtimes handle aggregation, deployment, and fault tolerance ( Bonawitz et al., 2019 ; Roth et al., 2022 ) , but they start from a federation that already exists: sites that can each emit records under one shared interface and task code that consumes them. We define federation formation as selecting task-eligible sites and preparing their local data and task code for federated training or analysis. Even within an established FL alliance holding structured data , preparing data for a particular FL task remains separate work: defining a shared data contract, writing conversion code against each site’s native annotations or clinical fields, and producing task code that runs on the result. This stage recurs per task , not per deployment: disc segmentation and disc detection over the same images need different contracts, adapters, and trainers. Even across a 52-database network that already shares a standardized schema, operators still report the need for feasibility feedback and coordinated code deployment ( Burkard et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 联邦学习让各机构无需集中其记录即可训练共享模型。 生产级运行时负责聚合、部署与容错，但它们都从一个已经存在的联邦出发：即各站点都能在同一共享接口下产生记录，且有消费这些记录的任务代码。 我们将联邦的构建定义为：选择符合任务条件的站点，并为其准备本地数据和任务代码，以进行联邦训练或分析。 即使在一个已建成、持有结构化数据的联邦学习联盟内部，为特定联邦学习任务准备数据仍是独立的工作：定义共享的数据契约、针对每个站点的原生标注或临床字段编写转换代码，并生成可在结果上运行的任务代码。 这一阶段按任务反复出现，而非按部署出现：对同一图像进行视盘分割和视盘检测需要不同的契约、适配器和训练器。 即使在一个已共享标准化模式的 52 数据库网络中，运营者仍然报告需要可行性反馈和协调的代码部署。

paragraphs.en: Automating this stage requires more than code generation. The evidence that decides whether a site qualifies sits behind that site’s disclosure boundary: a local codebook that says whether a numeric code means glaucoma, an annotation format that may or may not contain the requested structure, a duration field whose endpoint is defined only in a source publication. Under the configured disclosure policy, the FL server receives approved summaries rather than raw records and site-private mappings; public documentation can still inform interpretation. A common schema does not supply the missing meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化这一阶段所需要的不仅仅是代码生成。 判断某个站点是否符合条件所需的证据，位于该站点的披露边界之内：一份说明某个数字编码是否代表青光眼的本地编码本，一种可能包含、也可能不包含所需结构的标注格式，一个其终点仅在源文献中有定义的时长字段。 在所配置的披露策略下，联邦学习服务器接收的是经批准的摘要，而非原始记录和站点私有的映射；公开文档仍可为解释提供参考。 统一的模式并不能补齐缺失的含义。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents can now carry out much of this work ( Li et al., 2026 ; Saha et al., 2025 ) , but handing it to them raises a placement question that model quality alone does not answer. A server agent cannot verify a predicate over evidence it cannot see. A site agent that emits plausible adapter code has not shown that the code produces correct records. A reporting agent that finds an error in a log has not shown that the job failed. Each is an ownership failure: a component decides something whose evidence or authority belongs elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体现在可以完成这类工作中的很大一部分（Li et al., 2026；Saha et al., 2025），但把它们交给智能体会引出一个仅靠模型质量无法回答的部署位置问题。 服务器智能体无法对其看不见的证据验证某个谓词。 发出看似合理的适配器代码的站点智能体，并不能证明该代码会产生正确的记录。 在日志中发现错误的报告智能体，并不能证明作业失败了。 每一个都是所有权上的失败：某个组件对证据或权限本属于其他地方的事情做出了决定。

paragraphs.en: FedReady performs federation formation with agents bounded by view (evidence they may observe), output (artifacts they may propose), and authority (they cannot accept artifacts or admit sites). Server agents draft the contract and task code; site agents write adapters. The runtime owns transport, per-site state, and artifact acceptance, requiring checks tied to each artifact’s digest. With participating sites and artifacts fixed, readiness agents stop and ordinary FL training or analysis begins (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: FedReady 在受视图（智能体可观察的证据）、输出（智能体可提出的制品）和权限（智能体不能接受制品或准入站点）约束的智能体范围内执行联邦形成。 服务器智能体起草合同和任务代码；站点智能体编写适配器。 运行时负责传输、各站点状态和制品接受，并要求与每个制品的摘要绑定的检查。 当参与站点和制品固定后，就绪智能体停止，进入常规的联邦学习训练或分析（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: The central design rule is to place each decision at the boundary that owns its evidence . Within a fixed formation episode, terminal exclusion loses eligible sites; retained ineligible sites remain removable by later checks. FedReady assigns high-recall candidate site discovery to the server and local eligibility verification to site verifiers that execute generated adapters against locally supported semantics. On 39 simulated retinal sites and four tasks, this pipeline screens out 17 ineligible candidates against the evaluator’s ledger, without sending raw evidence to the FL server. The hosted coding provider is a separate trust boundary (Section 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 核心设计规则是将每个决策放置在拥有其证据的边界上。 在固定的编队回合内，终止排除会淘汰符合条件的站点；保留的不合格站点仍可在后续检查中被移除。 FedReady 将高召回率的候选站点发现分配给服务器，将本地资格验证分配给站点验证器，后者针对本地支持的语义执行生成的适配器。 在39个模拟视网膜站点和四个任务上，该流水线对照评估者的账本筛选出17个不合格候选站点，而无需向联邦学习服务器发送原始证据。 托管编码提供商是一个独立的信任边界（第4.2节）。

paragraphs.en: System. We build FedReady on a production FL runtime, NVIDIA FLARE ( Roth et al., 2022 ) , around runtime-owned artifact acceptance and evidence-based decision placement, with request-bound messages, per-site states that cannot skip required checks, task-code execution tests, and training from fixed verified inputs. An extension shares verified procedures among heterogeneous site agents (Section 4 ).

sents.en: Across 156 imaging site-task decisions, local eligibility verification removes all 17 discovery false positives without recall loss; four 100-round jobs complete, one with a generated contract.
sents.zh: 在 156 个影像站点-任务决策中，本地资格核验消除了全部 17 个发现假阳性且没有召回率损失；四个 100 轮的作业完成，其中一使用生成的契约。

sents.en: Seven of ten patient cohorts support analysis, with maximum survival-curve difference 0.001133 from the manual reference (Section 5 ).
sents.zh: 十个患者队列中有七个支持分析，与人工参考的最大生存曲线差异为 0.001133（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: Our sites are diverse public datasets simulated as private sites on one host. The evaluation therefore tests logical boundaries, site-selection correctness, and executability; it does not measure labor savings, formal privacy, or clinical validity (Section 6 ). paragraphs.en: Two features make formation a coordination problem rather than a fixed pipeline. First, capability is indexed by site and task : whether a site can supply a target depends on q q . Published metadata may be insufficient for a new target, so earlier site admission does not replace contract-specific verification. Second, the decisive artifacts are executable : a capability claim means little until code at that site produces contract-valid records, so discovery and code synthesis must be linked to execution-derived checks.
paragraphs.zh: 有两个特征使得编队成为一个协调问题，而不是一条固定的流水线。 第一，能力以站点和任务为索引：某个站点能否供应目标取决于 q q。 已发布的元数据对于新目标可能不够充分，因此站点的提前准入不能替代针对具体合约的验证。 第二，起决定作用的制品是可执行的：在该站点上的代码产出符合合约的有效记录之前，能力声明意义不大，因此发现与代码合成必须与基于执行的检查相挂钩。

Correctly screening out a site whose evidence does not support the target is a valid outcome, distinct from implementation failure. Our gates establish conformance to implemented predicates, not an independent clinical oracle.

paragraphs.en: We assume honest-but-fallible agents, malformed generated artifacts, accidental over-disclosure, ambiguous source semantics, and backend or transport failures. The FL runtime is a centralized control plane; evidence stays decentralized at the sites. We do not defend against a malicious host, provide OS-grade confinement of generated code, or establish differential privacy. In the evaluated configuration a hosted coding worker operates under a site-scoped access policy, so keeping records out of cross-site messages does not prove non-observation by its provider.
paragraphs.zh: 我们假设智能体诚实但可能出错，生成的制品可能格式错误，可能出现意外的过度披露、源语义歧义，以及后端或传输故障。 联邦学习运行时是一个集中式控制平面；证据保留在各站点的本地。 我们不防御恶意主机，不为生成的代码提供操作系统级的隔离，也不建立差分隐私。 在所评估的配置中，托管的编码工作进程在站点范围的访问策略下运行，因此将记录排除在跨站点消息之外并不能证明其提供方未观察到这些记录。

paragraphs.en: Artifact acceptance approves generated contracts or code; site admission accepts verified sites into the federation; a state transition records workflow progress. These are separate runtime decisions. Three invariants, each enforced by an interface rather than a prompt, organize the design: scope (I1: a record-level observation cannot silently become a site-level veto), proposal (I2: agent output is never a verifier result), and terminal state (I3: the runtime’s completion evidence, not a narrative or log token, determines success).
paragraphs.zh: 工件验收用于批准生成的合同或代码；站点准入用于将已验证的站点纳入联邦；状态转换用于记录工作流进度。 这些是相互独立的运行时决策。 三条不变式，每条都由接口而非提示词来强制执行，共同组织了整个设计：范围（I1：记录级别的观察不能悄然变成站点级别的否决）、提案（I2：智能体的输出绝不是验证器的结果）以及终止状态（I3：决定成败的是运行时的完成证据，而不是叙述或日志令牌）。

paragraphs.en: Assuming an honest host and intact acceptance interfaces, every accepted contract, adapter/manifest, and trainer carries a runtime-owned attestation (verification record) bound to the digest (content hash) of its reviewed bytes.

paragraphs.en: Disclosure has two channels. Cross-site FL messages exclude records, codebooks, source paths, adapter source, and manifests, using typed status, counts, reason codes, booleans, digests, and authorized summaries instead. Optional semantic redaction preserves required fields and is runtime-audited. Separately, the hosted coding provider receives prompts and tool-visible content: local file reads can expose documentation, paths, record excerpts, code, and diagnostics. Site-scoped tools do not imply local model inference; a local VLM does not protect this coding channel. We have not audited complete provider-bound traffic. These are coarse flow controls ( Sabelfeld and Myers, 2003 ) , not a privacy guarantee.
paragraphs.zh: 披露有两条通道。 跨站点联邦学习消息不包含记录、码本、源路径、适配器源代码和清单，而是使用带类型的状态、计数、原因代码、布尔值、摘要和经授权的摘要。 可选的语义脱敏会保留必需字段，并在运行时接受审计。 另外，托管式编码提供方会接收提示词和工具可见内容：本地文件读取可能暴露文档、路径、记录摘录、代码和诊断信息。 站点范围的工具并不意味着本地模型推理；本地视觉语言模型并不能保护这条编码通道。 我们尚未审计完整的发往提供方的流量。 这些是粗粒度的流控制（Sabelfeld and Myers, 2003），而非隐私保证。

paragraphs.en: The server resolves a versioned data contract from q q and redacted site profiles. The contract specifies required structure, meaning, and constraints; its schema defines the structural part. The interface is how task code consumes the prepared records under that contract. Built-in contracts cover binary segmentation and image-level classification. For a new task family, an agent proposes a contract, and a separate request produces a materializer that converts adapter outputs to its schema. Required fields, types, invariants, and synthetic test data construction are checked before dispatch. The contract owns the invariants, so generated code cannot invent exclusion rules, and adapter execution binds to the selected contract and materializer digests.

paragraphs.en: A site agent checks task support against authorized inputs and proposes an adapter and manifest. paragraphs.en: Local contrastive-guidance generation. After verified preparation, a designated contributing site abstracts its procedure into shared guidance with site-specific details removed. Lessons derive from verified success or an actually resolved failure and cannot invent a failure history.

paragraphs.en: Global distillation. The server distills validated lessons into common steps and conditional procedures gated on receiver-local evidence, removing donor paths, examples, adapters, numeric codebooks, and unresolved conflicts. Lessons explain how to investigate , not another site’s label meanings. Provenance checks do not prove correctness or absence of leakage. Site agents first attempt independently; unresolved implementations may retry with shared guidance under unchanged local verifiers, and verified successes may contribute lessons. Completed sites do not rerun; justified screening is not reversed. Retries stop when preparation completes, no new shared guidance is produced, or the attempt limit is reached. The aim is repeatable success within existing capability, not guaranteed rescue (Section 6 ).

paragraphs.en: We ask five questions across two modalities: RQ1 (site admission): do candidate site discovery and local eligibility verification select the correct sites under the disclosure policy? RQ2 (new task interface): can the fixed protocol build and execute a new task interface? RQ3 (training and analysis): do accepted packages execute, and how closely does tabular analysis match the manual reference? RQ4 (agent configurations): how does readiness vary across agents and harnesses? RQ5 (failures): which boundaries do development failures violate? Imaging and tabular studies use distinct coordinators, not one combined run.

paragraphs.en: We register 39 public retinal packages, following the population listed by FedAgentBench ( Saha et al., 2025 ) , as simulated private sites. paragraphs.en: Ten public colorectal-cancer patient cohorts (seven GEO series, TCGA colon and rectal cohorts, and an Ethiopian cohort) contain 2,189 source records, including controls. The authors separately prepared reference populations and analysis (the manual reference). Both methods use the same checksum-bound pool of 98 clinical-metadata and documentation files; expression matrices, manual adapters, prepared reference tables, and reference outputs are unavailable to live agents. The task is to construct supported populations for endpoint-specific survival analysis, not to pool different endpoints under one schema. As Table 3 shows, a value can have the right type but the wrong endpoint, event polarity, time origin, analysis unit, or population. Identity, applicability, and eligibility must precede target-completeness filtering, and a supported target can coexist with an unsupported covariate. A dedicated tabular coordinator reuses the architecture and agent bridge of Section 4 , not the unchanged imaging controller.

paragraphs.en: Both studies run public sources as private-site stand-ins on one host. The tabular clients are source patient cohorts, not ten verified independent hospitals; cross-source patient overlap is unresolved. For imaging, an evaluator-owned ledger, never exposed to agents or used as an admission allow-list, defines eligibility from locally available evidence: spatial tasks need provable target supervision, and classification needs explicit local diagnosis meaning rather than structural proxies or undocumented numeric codes. We report discovery precision and recall, final site admissions, and completion of 100-round jobs. Prediction metrics are unweighted means of available client validation scalars, not pooled patient-level scores. For tables, we report supported versus held endpoints by source, endpoint-specific record and event counts, monthly survival-curve agreement with the manual reference, and a separately implemented arithmetic check on the agent’s accepted inputs. Neither study measures a matched speedup or predictive superiority over a baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 两项研究均在单台主机上以公开数据源充当私有站点的替代品。 表格数据的客户端是来源患者队列，而非十家经过验证的独立医院；跨数据源的患者重叠问题尚未解决。 对于影像数据，由评估方维护的台账（绝不向智能体暴露，也不用作准入白名单）基于本地可得的证据来定义合格性：空间任务需要可证明的目标监督，分类任务需要明确的本地诊断含义，而非结构性代理或无文档说明的数字编码。 我们报告发现阶段的精确率与召回率、最终站点准入情况，以及 100 轮任务的完成情况。 预测指标是各客户端可用验证标量的无权重均值，而非合并的患者级评分。 对于表格数据，我们按数据源报告支持与未支持的终点、各终点的记录数与事件数、与人工参考的月度生存曲线一致性，以及对智能体所接受输入的单独实现的算术校验。 两项研究都没有测量相对于基线的匹配加速比或预测优越性。

paragraphs.en: All ten tabular workflows completed; seven supplied supported populations. paragraphs.en: Detection was also a generated-contract probe. The runtime contains generic field and storage validation, but no checked-in detection contract, materializer, renderer, adapter, or fallback trainer. From the request and redacted site profiles, the server generated an image-box contract and materializer, eight site agents converted their own contours or masks into locally verified boxes, and the server coder produced a Faster R-CNN-style package that passed contract-preserving simulation and completed 100 rounds. Three interfaces (shared schema, local conversion, shared trainer) changed at run time while authority, message binding, and gates stayed fixed. This is one task-family probe, not evidence of arbitrary task generality.
paragraphs.zh: 检测同样是一个生成式契约探针。 运行时包含通用的字段与存储校验，但没有已入库的检测契约、物化器、渲染器、适配器或后备训练器。 从请求与脱敏后的站点档案出发，服务器生成了图像框契约与物化器，八个站点智能体将各自的轮廓或掩码转换为本地验证过的框，服务器编码器产出了一个 Faster R-CNN 风格的软件包，该软件包通过了保持契约的仿真并完成了 100 轮。 三个接口（共享模式、本地转换、共享训练器）在运行时发生了变化，而权威、消息绑定与门控保持不变。 这是一个任务族探针，并非任意任务通用性的证据。

Archived attribution lists four stage-0 and four prior-treated records held only by the agent, and one primary-case record included only by the agent: seven fewer patients and two fewer events overall. paragraphs.en: Shared guidance may stabilize an agent capable of independent but unreliable success, not rescue persistent incapability. Testing this hypothesis requires repeated, equal-budget trials with and without shared guidance, establishing standalone success and comparing verified success rates. Zero successes in finite controls do not prove incapability; this checkpoint establishes neither stability gains nor a necessary capability threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 共享指导可以稳定一个能够独立但不稳定地成功的智能体，却无法拯救持续性的无能。 验证这一假设需要在与共享指导条件下进行多次等预算的重复试验，确立独立成功的基线并比较经验证的成功率。 有限对照试验中的零成功并不能证明无能；此检查点既未确立稳定性的提升，也未确立必要的能力门槛。

paragraphs.en: Clinical-data transformation and loading took over six person-months initially, versus one to two for a subsequent health system with partially transferable code and knowledge ( FitzHenry et al., 2015 ) ; different sources preclude a causal reuse estimate. Nursing flowsheet mapping logged 95.33 concept-mapping and 74.75 value-mapping hours ( Austin et al., 2025 ) . FLEX-LLM-CARE estimates a reduction from 360 to 149 expert-hours (59% reduction) from historical timelines and expert feedback, retaining 40 hours for semantic validation ( Marfoglia et al., 2025 ) . These reports motivate a matched preparation study rather than serving as per-adapter baselines for FedReady.

paragraphs.en: The main paper’s artifact-acceptance property is structural and conditional on intact acceptance interfaces, not machine-checked. An honest host is not necessarily bug-free: WF-004 accidentally lost approved contract fields during synthetic test data construction. This motivates testing the entire contract-to-test-data-to-executor path; the property alone does not establish that every host transformation implements its intended interface. The authority-placement proposition assumes an active site set that only shrinks, no re-entry after exclusion, and the existence of a later stage whose view contains the evidence for the deferred predicate and whose implementation of that predicate is sound and complete. Dropping the evidence or verifier assumption makes the “correctable” half vacuous. The eligible set is fixed within the modeled episode. Re-admission would relax the unrecoverability conclusion; versioned re-admission could remain auditable, but is not evaluated here.
paragraphs.zh: 主论文的制品可接受性是结构性的，并依赖于验收接口完好这一条件，而非经过机器验证。 诚实的宿主不一定没有缺陷：WF-004 在构建合成测试数据时意外丢失了已批准的契约字段。 这提示我们需要对从契约到测试数据再到执行器的整条路径进行测试；仅凭该性质并不能确立每个宿主变换都实现了其预期的接口。 权威放置命题假设存在一个只收缩、排除后不再重新进入的活跃站点集合，并且假设存在一个后续阶段，其视图包含延迟谓词的证据，且该阶段对该谓词的实现是可靠且完备的。 若去掉证据或验证者假设，「可纠正」这一半就会变得空洞。 合格集合在所建模的回合内是固定的。 重新准入会削弱不可恢复性的结论；带版本控制的重新准入仍可保持可审计，但本文未对此进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Schema-bounded release is a coarse flow policy, not a privacy guarantee. Aggregate counts, split sizes, reason codes, timing, and the mere fact of a screened_out response are all side channels, and repeated queries against a stable population compose. Protecting per-client messages and protecting released aggregates are separate requirements. Secure aggregation may hide individual contributions under its assumptions, but does not itself protect a disclosed curve or a single-client endpoint. Noise would require a specified privacy mechanism and accounting; neither protection is implemented here, and we make no differential-privacy claim.

paragraphs.en: The study uses public research datasets, selected following the retinal list of ( Saha et al., 2025 ) and downloaded from their original or mirrored public hosts, then registered as simulated sites; all source licenses remain in force and no clinical decision is made anywhere in the pipeline. Automated site admission carries a specific risk: a site with a bad or ambiguous codebook can be admitted on the strength of a locally plausible interpretation, and a site with an unusual acquisition style can be excluded for reasons that are correct under the contract but undesirable epidemiologically. The protocol mitigates neither automatically. It instead makes both visible: every exclusion carries a typed reason code and every site admission carries an adapter digest and manifest. It performs no autonomous relabeling, deletion, or repair of site data. Lower setup friction is the intended benefit and also the main hazard: it becomes cheaper to stand up a federation with the wrong participating sites. Checked artifact acceptance does not prevent that outcome; it makes it auditable after the fact.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究使用公开研究数据集，这些数据集按照 ( Saha et al., 2025 ) 的视网膜列表选定，并从其原始或镜像的公共托管处下载，随后注册为模拟站点；所有源许可仍然有效，且整个流程中不做出任何临床决策。 自动化站点准入存在一个特定风险：拥有糟糕或含混码本的站点可能仅凭一个局部看似合理的解释而被准入，而采集方式不寻常的站点可能因在合同上正确但在流行病学上不合意的原因而被排除。 该协议并不自动缓解这两种情况。 相反，它使两者都可见：每一次排除都带有类型化的原因码，每一次站点准入都带有适配器摘要和清单。 它不会对站点数据执行任何自主的重新标注、删除或修复。 更低的搭建门槛既是预期收益，也是主要隐患：搭建一个包含错误参与站点的联邦变得更便宜了。 经过检查的制品接受机制并不能阻止这种结果；它只是使这种结果在事后可被审计。

paragraphs.en: The prototype is implemented in Python on NVIDIA FLARE. Live agent requests use a shared typed interface carrying role, action, expected schema, context, site identity, and request identifier. The primary four-workload snapshot used the hosted Codex configuration for server planning and task-code generation and for site-agent adapter coding; adapter workers were launched at the site boundary with policy-bounded access to the corresponding data directory. Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct was served through a client-local vLLM-compatible endpoint for bounded visual checks during local adaptation. The client runtime rejects non-local endpoints for dedicated VLM requests. Only typed verification summaries cross that FLARE boundary; coding-provider access is a separate channel described above. Training packages use PyTorch 2.x and MONAI 1.4+ interfaces where appropriate.

paragraphs.en: The main paper’s three-row comparison uses three fresh runs in total: one matched full-workflow control and one run for each ablation, not three repetitions per configuration. paragraphs.en: The Luna-only study assigns Luna-low site agents through the Codex harness to the same 39 sites, without shared guidance. paragraphs.en: Optic-disc and optic-cup segmentation require locally provable spatial supervision for the requested structure and a readable compatible input image. Contour coordinates, binary masks, soft maps, and documented multi-value masks are eligible if a local adapter can convert them without inventing semantics; the main paper’s local-translation figure contrasts these encodings with the required binary disc mask. Glaucoma classification requires explicit local evidence mapping records to glaucoma or referable-glaucoma status; structural proxies, undocumented numeric codes, abbreviations without local definition, or dataset-name memory are insufficient. Detection requires the disc-eligible source plus a generated contract that defines normalized or pixel-coordinate boxes consistently with the generated trainer.

paragraphs.en: We run a read-only audit over all retained development artifacts through August 11, 2026; coverage is exhaustive within that archive, not over all attempted executions. The audit inventories 254,854 files in 87 candidate workflow, test, or pilot roots; analyzes all 89,113 text/structured artifacts (626.7 MB); parses 153,672 JSON documents or JSONL rows; and reconciles incidents with code history, retry artifacts, or contemporaneous diagnosis. An incident enters the taxonomy only when a real run shows a causal artifact chain. Evidence grade E1 additionally requires a validating retry or regression test; E2 requires a timestamped run plus code or documented diagnosis. Constructed red-team cases and unobserved invariants are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对截至2026年8月11日保留的所有开发产物进行只读审计；覆盖范围在该档案库内是穷尽的，而非覆盖所有尝试过的执行。 该审计清点了87个候选工作流、测试或试点根目录下的254,854个文件；分析了全部89,113个文本/结构化产物（626.7 MB）；解析了153,672个JSON文档或JSONL行；并将事件与代码历史、重试产物或同期诊断记录进行了核对。 只有当真实运行显示出因果性的产物链条时，事件才被纳入分类体系。 证据等级E1还要求存在验证性的重试或回归测试；E2要求存在带时间戳的运行记录以及代码或书面诊断。 构造的红队测试用例和未被观测到的不变量均被排除。

paragraphs.en: Classifying each incident by what it violated rather than by the component that surfaced it gives four disjoint classes.

paragraphs.en: Authority , I2 (5): a role decided outside its ownership, or a self-reported success was consumed as a verifier result: WF-003 and WF-008 (generated materializers inventing undeclared invariants), WF-009 (an adapter inventing label semantics from pixel values), WF-010 and WF-023 (backend outcomes consumed as data outcomes).
paragraphs.zh: 权威，I2（5）：所有权之外决定的角色，或将自我报告的成功当作验证者结果使用：WF-003 和 WF-008（生成的物化器发明了未声明的不变量）、WF-009（适配器从像素值发明标签语义）、WF-010 和 WF-023（后端结果被当作数据结果使用）。

paragraphs.en: Scope , I1 and I3 (5): a fact changed state at a granularity, or through a channel, that its evidence does not license: WF-001 (a path token deciding record semantics) and WF-007 (redaction removing evidence needed for candidate site discovery) violate I1; WF-006 (a log line overriding completion evidence), WF-017 (one client rejection aborting a run), and WF-018 (a reporting call overriding runtime facts) violate I3.
paragraphs.zh: 范围、I1 和 I3（5）：某一事实在某种粒度上、或通过某种通道改变了状态，而其证据并不允许这种改变：WF-001（路径令牌决定记录语义）和 WF-007（脱敏移除了发现候选站点所需的证据）违反了 I1；WF-006（一条日志行覆盖完成证据）、WF-017（一次客户端拒绝中止整个运行）以及 WF-018（一次报告调用覆盖运行时事实）违反了 I3。

paragraphs.en: State loss (5): a negotiated or accepted artifact was mutated, re-encoded, or resolved against the wrong base between acceptance and use: WF-004, WF-005, WF-014, WF-015, WF-021.
paragraphs.zh: 状态丢失 (5)：一个已协商或已被接受的制品在“接受”与“使用”之间被修改、重新编码，或基于错误的基础进行了解析：WF-004、WF-005、WF-014、WF-015、WF-021。

paragraphs.en: Environment (4): a defect that surfaced only when the exact deployed code and runtime executed: WF-016, WF-019, WF-020, WF-022.
paragraphs.zh: 环境 (4)：仅在实际部署的代码和运行时执行时才暴露出来的缺陷：WF-016、WF-019、WF-020、WF-022。

paragraphs.en: A directory seg_dataset/{glaucoma,normal} contained 4,217 classification images. A structural parser interpreted the weak token “seg” as mask evidence and omitted the class-folder evidence from the shareable profile. The round-1 agent reasonably returned “not applicable” (a site-screening outcome), the client never reached its local adapter, and the workflow reported success. After narrowing the parser’s ownership rule, a one-client replay produced a verified 4,217-record manifest. The agent could not recover evidence it was never shown; the fault belonged to the candidate site discovery interface.
paragraphs.zh: 目录 seg_dataset/{glaucoma,normal} 中包含 4,217 张分类图像。 结构解析器将弱标记“seg”解读为掩码证据，并从可共享的画像中遗漏了类别文件夹证据。 第 1 轮的智能体合理地返回了“不适用”（一种站点筛选结果），客户端从未到达其本地适配器，而工作流却报告了成功。 在收窄解析器的归属规则后，单客户端重放生成了经过验证的 4,217 条记录的清单。 智能体无法恢复它从未见过的证据；该故障属于候选站点发现接口。

paragraphs.en: The agent-generated detection trainer included the required contract fields, but host-side synthetic test data construction discarded them. Seven revisions could not repair the host’s corrupted view. Preserving the full approved contract enabled task-code execution tests and later training. paragraphs.en: The 98-file selector binds clinical metadata, original publications, dictionaries, and mechanically extracted reading copies. Gene-expression inputs, manual mappings and policy files, prepared tables, and previous agent artifacts are excluded. Fresh execution regenerates summaries, contracts, adapters, and decisions, but these patient cohorts were used in earlier prompt and reference development. This is a fresh-execution test, not an untouched held-out benchmark. The manual implementation was separately written and documented, but provides neither independent clinical adjudication nor an unquestionable oracle.

paragraphs.en: GDC files contain cases with nested diagnoses and follow-ups. The adapter must emit the agreed case-level unit rather than treating every nested object as an independent participant. Source IDs, join cardinality, and retained output identity require local checks and crosswalks. For GEO, sample accessions can support mechanical linkage without independently verifying unique patients. In GSE35896, all 62 secondary clinical IDs match GEO samples, but this join neither authenticates the clinical mirror nor resolves conflicting attributes. Cross-client patient overlap is not established by within-client uniqueness.
paragraphs.zh: GDC 文件包含具有嵌套诊断和随访的病例。 适配器必须输出约定的病例级单元，而不是把每个嵌套对象都当作独立的受试者。 源 ID、连接基数以及保留的输出标识需要进行本地检查和交叉对照。 对于 GEO，样本登录号可以在不独立验证患者唯一性的情况下支持机械化的关联。 在 GSE35896 中，全部 62 个次要临床 ID 都与 GEO 样本匹配，但这种连接既不能验证临床镜像的真实性，也无法解决相互冲突的属性。 客户端内部标识的唯一性并不能确立跨客户端的患者重叠关系。

paragraphs.en: Overall survival, disease-free survival, and colorectal-cancer-specific survival remain separate endpoint families. TCGA OS combines vital status with death or follow-up durations in the selected case/diagnosis context. Native months are converted to years only where documentation supports the unit. Numerical ranges, coherent date ordering, and plausible distributions do not independently define units, event polarity, censoring, death handling, or time origin. Ethiopia’s event definition counts CRC death, while censoring does not imply that a patient is known to be alive; a chronology contradiction remains held. The workflow does not replace documented duration fields with a guessed date-derived target or clip contradictory durations into validity.
paragraphs.zh: 总生存期、无病生存期和结直肠癌特异性生存期仍保持为相互独立的终点类别。 TCGA 总生存期在所选病例/诊断情境下将生存状态与死亡或随访时长相结合。 仅在文档支持该单位的情况下，才将原始的月份数转换为年。 数值范围、连贯的日期顺序以及合理的分布并不能独立定义单位、事件极性、删失、死亡处理方式或时间起点。 埃塞俄比亚的事件定义计入结直肠癌死亡，而删失并不意味着已知患者存活；时间顺序上的矛盾仍保持不变。 该工作流不会用推测的、由日期衍生的目标替换已记录的时长字段，也不会将相互矛盾的时长裁剪成有效值。

paragraphs.en: Eligibility and endpoint applicability precede missing-target handling. Normal tissue, ambiguous primary origin, prior treatment, and subgroup restrictions are accounted for explicitly. In GSE14333, primary DFS uses 185 Dukes B/C records with 48 recurrences. The manual reference preserves 226 A/B/C records with 50 events as a separate sensitivity population; 41 complete stage-A pairs are not silently included in primary analysis. For GSE37892, including only records with recorded metastasis would select on the outcome, so complete arithmetic for that subset is insufficient to justify a survival estimate for the full patient cohort.
paragraphs.zh: 资格与终点的适用性判断先于缺失目标值的处理。 正常组织、原发灶不明、既往治疗以及亚组限制均被显式纳入考虑。 在 GSE14333 中，主要无病生存期（DFS）分析使用 185 例 Dukes B/C 期记录，其中含 48 例复发。 手动参考标准保留 226 例 A/B/C 期记录、50 例事件，作为一个单独的敏感性分析人群；41 例完整的 A 期配对数据不会被悄悄纳入主要分析。 对于 GSE37892，仅纳入有转移记录的病例会引入针对结局的选择偏倚，因此仅凭该子集的完整算术计算不足以证明可以对全队列患者给出生存估计。

paragraphs.en: A supported survival target can coexist with an unsupported covariate. Disputed sex codes, unknown staging systems, and ambiguous age reference points retain native values and uncertainty rather than forcing a crosswalk. Dukes stages are not silently converted to AJCC stages; AJCC/TNM edition and source context are retained where available. GDC age-at-index is not automatically age-at-diagnosis, and unknown obfuscation flags remain unknown. A disagreement in one covariate need not exclude otherwise supported endpoints, whereas complete covariates cannot rescue an undefined endpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 受支持的生存目标可以与不受支持的协变量共存。 有争议的性别编码、未知的分期系统和模糊的年龄参考点保留原始值和不确定性，而不是强行进行映射转换。 Dukes 分期不会被静默转换为 AJCC 分期；在可用时保留 AJCC/TNM 版本和来源上下文。 GDC 的索引时年龄不会自动视为诊断时年龄，且未知的混淆标志仍保持未知。 单个协变量的不一致无需排除其余受支持的终点，而完整的协变量也无法挽救一个未定义的终点。

paragraphs.en: Native DFS_Time , DFS_Cens , and DukesStage are reconciled with the publication’s patient/statistical methods ( Jorissen et al., 2009 ) , recurrence counts, and duration distributions. For the documented B/C population, the issued mapping is duration_years=DFS_Time/12 and event=1-DFS_Cens . This is documentary-plus-aggregate corroboration, not a recovered literal deposited codebook. The contract reconciles 94 stage-B and 91 stage-C records to 185 ready targets, while 44 stage-A and 61 stage-D records are held. Its local dfs_transform_violations measure must be zero and its unique-output count must be 290. The manual audit identifies 226 complete A/B/C pairs, including 41 complete A pairs, and 64 missing native pairs overall: completeness cannot determine primary eligibility. The publication and deposit differ by three B/C records; current deposit counts are not forced to match historical publication counts. Documentary age units and matching aggregate range/median support Age_Diag in years. DukesStage remains Dukes without an assumed AJCC crosswalk.

paragraphs.en: The CRC-specific publication ( Teka et al., 2021 ) defines the endpoint and diagnosis origin; the broader data publication PMC8367784 supplies a colorectal life table. Native VSTATUS / statusfn agree across all 161 released records. Their 75 events and the 2,937-person-month total corroborate TIME / VSTATUS ; the reference reports reproduction of all 36 published risk/death/censor cells before exclusion. The final mapping uses TIME/12 and VSTATUS=1 for CRC death; 0 denotes censoring, not necessarily known-alive status. Date_Dx / Date_death reveal one endpoint date before diagnosis while TIME is zero. That record remains held, leaving 160 ready records and 74 events; dates do not overwrite TIME . Documentary disagreement in numeric Sex coding remains unresolved and raw. Published/native follow-up discrepancies also remain limitations rather than being erased by matching totals.

paragraphs.en: Staged GDC dictionary/term definitions and outcome methods ( Liu et al., 2018 ) inform entity roles, day offsets, and OS construction. paragraphs.en: Native os.delay (months) / os.event supply explicit units and candidate OS coding. dataset=Non Tumoral identifies 19 controls among 585 samples. paragraphs.en: Mirror ID_REF matches all 62 GEO accessions and offers DFS (in months) , DFS event , Age (in years) , and Gender . paragraphs.en: GSE33113 tissue separates 90 tumors from six normal specimens. The initial audit finds 89 complete recurrence pairs and 18 yes records, including time 1278 under a flag labeled within 3 years . This warns against inferring units from range or assuming no means event-free censoring. GEO metadata and the available publication abstract do not resolve all required meanings; targets stay null. GSE37892’s three dates yield 130 mechanically calculable intervals, including 37 recorded metastases, and chronology checks succeed. Series/sample metadata and the primary abstract support patient-cohort scope but do not define absent-date censoring or death handling. All targets remain held; selecting only the 37 metastases would bias the population. Aggregate review also challenges normalized Stage when its staging system is unknown. Unsupported stage and age units remain raw.

paragraphs.en: The final run permits at most five corrective cycles and five analysis attempts. paragraphs.en: The manual-reference comparison is a distinct evaluation: live agents did not receive the manual adapters, selection policies, prepared tables, or reference outputs. Thus it is not a comparison of the generated application to itself. However, both implementations were developed by the authors on these patient cohorts and can share interpretation errors. Numerical verification, reference agreement, and external clinical adjudication are different evidence levels; only the first two are reported. Independent eligibility validation would require blinded source-to-output review, including the disputed record selections, sources with held endpoints, endpoint definitions, and time origins.
paragraphs.zh: 手册参照对比是一项独立的评估：在线智能体并未获得手册适配器、选择策略、预先准备的表格或参照输出。 因此，这并不是将生成的应用程序与其自身进行比较。 然而，两种实现均由作者在这些患者队列上开发，可能存在共同的解释错误。 数值验证、参照一致性和外部临床裁定属于不同的证据等级；本文仅报告了前两项。 独立的资格验证需要对源数据到输出的盲法审查，包括有争议的记录选择、保留终点的数据源、终点定义以及时间起点。

paragraphs.en: The archived offline comparison requires identical, unique monthly grids and compares risk, event, censor, and survival values. DFS and CRC-specific survival agree at all evaluated points. OS differs by at most 0.0011329628355009058 in survival probability. The experiment summary reports nine record-selection differences: four stage-0 GSE39582 cases and four prior-treated TCGA records held only by the agent, and one TCGA_COAD case included only by the agent because of primary-case interpretation. The net difference is seven fewer patients and two fewer events in the agent population. These are policy-sensitive selection disagreements, not nine independently established agent errors. Similar aggregate curves can coexist with different inclusion policies, so adjudicating these boundaries is a separate task from verifying the product-limit calculation.
paragraphs.zh: 归档的离线比较要求每月网格完全相同且唯一，并比较风险、事件、删失和生存值。 DFS 和 CRC 特异性生存率在所有评估点上均一致。 OS 在生存概率上最多相差 0.0011329628355009058。 实验摘要报告了九处记录选择差异：四例仅有智能体纳入的 0 期 GSE39582 病例、四例仅有智能体纳入的既往接受过治疗的 TCGA 记录，以及一例因原发病例解读原因而仅由智能体纳入的 TCGA_COAD 病例。 净差异是智能体人群少七名患者、少两个事件。 这些是对选择策略敏感的纳入分歧，而不是九个独立确立的智能体错误。 相似的总体曲线可能与不同的纳入策略并存，因此裁定这些边界是一项独立于验证乘积极限（product-limit）计算的任务。

paragraphs.en: The evaluated application sends per-site event/censor histograms in plaintext without a minimum-cell or tail-risk-set suppression rule. paragraphs.en: Stronger evidence requires repeated held-out runs, independent clinical adjudication of population boundaries, source-to-output record comparisons, documentation/contract/review ablations, and matched human preparation with ordinary coding assistance. Record human preparation and communication person-hours separately from machine cost and elapsed data-readiness time. Correctness must be matched before claiming efficiency; no observed human-time savings are established by this experiment.

paragraphs.en: Best validation values were classification accuracy 0.8861 at round 92 and detection GT recall@0.5 0.9742 at round 69; final classification balanced accuracy was 0.8372.
